editorial:
Imagine a world where ancient magic meets modern gunfire. You get to follow Callan, a hero who has a powerful cross amulet that gives him a serious edge in a fight. He is not alone, though, as he leads a crew of weapons experts who know exactly how to handle any situation. The vibe is very much like a comic book come to life, with high stakes and over-the-top villains named Muerte and Drago who want to tear Los Angeles apart. The coolest part is seeing Callan team up with Gunnar, a guy he used to hate, because the threat is just too big for one person to handle alone.

You will love the fast action and the way the team works together to stop the bad guys. While the special effects are a bit simple in some spots, the energy keeps you hooked from start to finish. It is a great pick if you just want to turn off your brain and enjoy some explosions.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a massive showdown between Callan and the villains. Using the power of the ancient cross amulet, Callan manages to outsmart Muerte and Drago in a final battle. He and Gunnar put their differences aside one last time to deliver the finishing blow. Once the villains are defeated, the city of Los Angeles is finally safe, and Callan's team celebrates their victory, knowing they stopped a disaster.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves comic book style action and supernatural powers.
